items.name: Nat.choose_le_pow_div
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Semifield α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] (r n : ℕ),
  ↑(n.choose r) ≤ ↑n ^ r / ↑r.factorial

items.name: Finset.prod_pow_choose_succ
items.type:
∀ {M : Type u_2} [inst : CommMonoid M] (f : ℕ → ℕ → M) (n : ℕ),
  ∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 2), f i (n + 1 - i) ^ (n + 1).choose i =
    (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), f i (n + 1 - i) ^ n.choose i) *
      ∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), f (i + 1) (n - i) ^ n.choose i

items.name: norm_prod_le_of_le
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_3} {E : Type u_5} [inst : SeminormedCommGroup E] (s : Finset ι) {f : ι → E} {n : ι → ℝ},
  (∀ b ∈ s, ‖f b‖ ≤ n b) → ‖∏ b ∈ s, f b‖ ≤ ∑ b ∈ s, n b
